name: klarpdf
description: Local, offline PDF engine for agents: read, transform, and verifiably redact.
long_description: Exposes KlarPDF's PDF engine to Claude Desktop as MCP tools. Read a document without pulling it whole into context (get_info, get_outline, search, extract_text, render_page); transform it losslessly to a new file (split, merge, reorder, delete_pages, rotate, fill_form, flatten, export_images); and redact destructively with cross-engine leak verification, so the text is physically removed rather than covered by a black box. Every write tool takes an explicit output path and leaves the input byte-identical. The tools make no network connections.

tools.name: get_info
tools.description: Page count, size, encryption, text layer, outline.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find text; returns pages, snippets and boxes.

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render one page to a PNG image.

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: List every annotation, with notes, colours and boxes.

tools.name: extract_pages
tools.description: Write named pages out as one new PDF.

tools.name: delete_pages
tools.description: Write a copy without the named pages.

tools.name: reorder
tools.description: Write a copy with pages in a new order.

tools.name: rotate
tools.description: Turn pages by a multiple of 90 degrees.

tools.name: split
tools.description: Split into several PDFs by page range.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill AcroForm fields, keeping them editable.

tools.name: flatten
tools.description: Bake annotations and fields into page content.

tools.name: annotate
tools.description: Write highlights, underlines and strike-throughs, with notes.
